newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIERI WANTS TRANSFER TALKS PUT ON ICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIERI WANTS TRANSFER TALKS PUT ON ICE.

text.p: Juventus and Italy striker Christian Vieri would like his club to delay any negotiations on his possible transfer until the end of the season.
"Just at the moment, there are more important things to be thinking about such as...Parma, a title up for grabs and a Champions' Cup final", said Vieri.

With four serie A games to play, Juventus lead the championship by four points from second placed Parma. They play German side Borussia Dortmund in the European Cup final in Munich at the end of this month.
Vieri, 23, has had an impressive season with Juventus, culminating in his international debut for Italy in a 3-0 World Cup win against Moldova at Easter.

Italian media reports this week suggested Spanish side Atletico Madrid were close to concluding his transfer. They said Atletico had offered $17 million for Vieri plus an annual salary of around $1 million.
Earlier this week, Juventus honorary president Umberto Agnelli indicated Vieri might indeed be sold. He said the club had an obligation to take seriously any big money offers for any of its players.
That includes Vieri's striking partner Alessandro Del Piero, who has been linked with several big European club sides in recent days.
Agnelli said he hoped Del Piero would stay at Juventus but he said the club would consider offers from other teams.
